title: 3D Gaussian Splatting Round-Trip — Load, Export, Re-Import (.splat)
description: End-to-end check of the .splat exporter. Loads a captured interior (3D Gaussian Splatting, baked RGB, no spherical harmonics) into a temporary SceneModel, writes it back out with GaussianSplatExporter, then re-imports the exported bytes into the displayed SceneModel. Per-splat scales, colours and rotations survive exactly and centres survive to within 16-bit position quantisation, so the re-imported scene renders identically to the original. Browser only.
